title: Chapter 2954 - 178: Spoils of War
content:
Chapter 2954: Chapter 178: Spoils of War

Elder You immediately took out several talismans and ignited them one by one.

The strange Five Elements and Eight Trigrams magic was cast on "Shi Gu" one after another.

But the spells entered the dead flesh like spring water into a muddy swamp, showing only the ripples of the spell’s vibration without much destructive power.

Instead, "Shi Gu" actually absorbed a portion of the residual spiritual power from the spell’s vibration into its body.

Although the absorption rate was low, barely reaching even one percent of the spell’s power, this still made Elder You’s pupils tremble:

"The power of the spell has actually transformed into... spiritual power..."

Even though Elder You had been a Demon Sect Elder for quite some time, here in the Great Wilderness, he had also conducted numerous transactions with high-level corpse cultivators of the Yin Corpse Sect, and had seen many types of walking corpses, iron corpses, copper corpses, and strange corpses.

But this "corpse" before him still, to a certain extent, exceeded his understanding of Tao Cultivation.

Clearly a corpse, yet its aura was obscure, without the stench of decay.

Clearly the methods of the Evil Path, sinister and bizarre, yet there was not much evil qi evident.

And moreover, clearly a corpse, yet it was using spiritual power as energy supply.

Now even more inexplicably, this corpse seemed to have undergone some kind of evolution, showing signs of absorbing the power of spells.

This kind of "corpse refinement" technique is truly unimaginable.

The person who refined such a "zombie" must have profound knowledge in the Corpse Path, and certainly has comprehended some kind of power of laws that is incomprehensible to ordinary people.

Elder You tried to "struggle" a few more times.

He used a few more talismans and spells, but to "Shi Gu" it was no more than a tickle.

Without using his magic treasure, Elder You was certainly no match for Shi Gu.

Even if breaking the rule to use it, Elder You wasn’t sure he could actually "kill" Shi Gu.

And his own magical treasure, the ancestor had warned him repeatedly not to use it before truly mastering it, otherwise, it could ruin great events...

Elder You frowned deeply.

"Shi Gu," however, paid no heed to such matters; it only focused on killing.

And ever since the Twelve Scripture Gluttonous Spirit Corpse Formation was inscribed on Mo Hua, there seemed to be a connection between the master and servant, and "Shi Gu" itself underwent some mysterious changes, with its destructive power rising to a higher level.

In less than a hundred rounds, one of Elder You’s arms was forcibly torn off by "Shi Gu".

Moreover, there was a bloody wound on Elder You’s abdomen.

This wound was only two inches away from the dantian; had he dodged even a bit slower, "Shi Gu’s" corpse claw would have pierced his abdomen and ripped out his Golden Core.

Elder You felt both shocked and resentful.

Up until now, he had navigated both the black and white paths, doing deals with both the righteous and the wicked, but had never been so seriously wounded despite his strategic cunning.

Even his Golden Core was almost taken out...

Yet amidst his anger, he retained enough reason and clarity.

He knew he was no match for "Shi Gu".

And what was more dangerous was that his cause and effect must have been "exposed"; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been blocked at the doorstep.

This was a death trap against him; every moment of delay made the crisis more acute.

Elder You first crushed a jade order, summoning a seven-colored light shield to protect himself.

Then he ignited a book order to call for help, finally grabbing a flowing wind cloak and draping it over himself.

"Shi Gu" pounced forward, throwing a punch at the seven-colored light shield.

The seven-colored shield trembled but remained intact.

Inside the shield, Elder You breathed a sigh of relief.

But before he had fully exhaled, the Taotie pattern on "Shi Gu’s" body flashed, like a fierce beast roaring, strength coursing, and its fists shot out in rapid succession, delivering over a dozen punches in a short time.

Once these dozen punches were unleashed, the seven-colored light shield shattered instantly into dust.

Elder You’s heart jumped into his throat. Out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of "Shi Gu’s" deep, ghostly blue eyes, making his heart go cold.

"Shi Gu" thrust a punch directly at Elder You’s head.

If it struck, his head would certainly explode.

Elder You knew his head wouldn’t explode.

But he would lose his most crucial life and spirit cultivation method, his lifelong path of cultivation would spiral downward, irretrievable.

This was worse than killing him.

In his panic, a flying shuttle chain hammer magic artifact soared across the air, striking "Shi Gu’s" fist.

"Shi Gu’s" fist deflected, missing Elder You.

Elder You seized the opportunity to retreat a few steps, creating distance between him and Shi Gu.

As the escape light flickered, three Golden Core cultivators appeared, protecting Elder You in front.

All three wore black robes, their faces concealed, but their cultivation was remarkable, two at the Late Golden Core Stage and one at the Middle Phase.

They were "black-robed guardians" recruited by the Hua family with Spirit Stones for clandestine dealings.

This was within a Hua family stronghold.

If it weren’t because Elder You’s affairs were also "confidential," isolated from outsiders, someone would have come to aid him long before he ignited the book order.

Facing the obstruction by the three strong enemies, Shi Gu only followed orders, showing no fear, and continued its assault on Elder You.

Elder You took a step back.

The three black-robed guardians formed a defense around Elder You, each activating their magic artifact, engaging in combat with Shi Gu.

All three followed the body cultivation path, with magic artifacts suited for close combat: a flying shuttle chain hammer, a big ring saber, and iron-armored gauntlets.

Their joint effort increased their destructive power even more.
